name: drb_animation_sections
expr: PINA, KINA, OINA, MINA, LDCS, ODCS, KDCS, PDCS
evidence: Menu DRBs end with these tables: MINA names each clip, OINA/KDCS/PDCS map tracks and channels, KINA holds 32-byte keys (animkey1..animkey6 plus a PINA pointer), PINA holds the keyframe values, and LDCS/ODCS name dialog Start_ and Exit_ transitions with frame counts. The DRB relocator loads them into a heap context on the dialog resource (MINA count +0x00, MINA +0x04, OINA +0x08, KINA +0x0c, LDCS count +0x10, LDCS +0x14, ODCS +0x18, KDCS +0x1c, RTS +0x30, PAHS +0x38, RPTC +0x3c, LRTC +0x40, PINA +0x48, PDCS +0x4c) at 0x82bc1c18

name: mina_last_frame
evidence: lang/jp/menu/garage.drb.dcx MINA (last keyframe index, 0-based): FadeIn_5f = 4, FadeIn_10f = 9, FadeIn_15f = 14, FadeIn_20f = 19, Move_Left = 15, Move_Right = 15, Frame = 9, Frame1_grayout = 9, FadeIn = 0, FadeIn_10f_rv = 9, タイトル枠右 = 14, タイトル枠下 = 14, loaded by 0x82bc1c18

name: clip_length
evidence: inferred: LDCS start_@Acsis applies FadeIn_10f to most garage objects and the clip's last_frame is 9; the animation player advances one keyframe per 60 Hz menu frame

name: menu_tick
evidence: inferred from the *_5f/_10f/_15f/_20f/_60f clip names and the LDCS frame counts (the 360 menu steps once per video frame)

name: garage_entrance_start
evidence: LDCS start_@Acsis in lang/jp/menu/garage.drb.dcx: most objects use FadeIn_10f, @FOCUS 37, @InfoDialog 25, @Gradation 9 (the retail garage-front transition)
